dimensions.assessment: Affects Clark County, the City of North Las Vegas, the Apex Industrial Park Owners Association, and users of the Apex Project industrial park site in Nevada.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Department of the Interior to grant certain rights-of-way related to the Apex Project (an industrial park) to Clark County in Nevada, the city of North Las Vegas, and the Apex Industrial Park Owners Association

dimensions.assessment: Expedites federal land rights-of-way and adjusts mineral sales rules to support development of the industrial park.
dimensions.evidence: such sale shall be exempt from the quantity and term limitations imposed on noncompetitive sales

dimensions.assessment: Involves mineral material sales from surface activities on specific parcels, but does not provide specific federal budget or spending figures.
Amends the Apex Project, Nevada Land Transfer and Authorization Act of 1989 to add entities, mandate rights-of-way, and alter mineral sales exemptions.
dimensions.evidence: The Apex Project, Nevada Land Transfer and Authorization Act of 1989 (Public Law 101-67; 103 Stat. 168) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Includes permanent provisions, such as land withdrawals continuing in perpetuity.
dimensions.evidence: The withdrawal made by this subsection shall continue in perpetuity for all lands transferred in accordance with this subsection.

missing_information: Specific monetary values or revenue projections expected from mineral material sales.
importance_detail.rationale: The Apex Area Technical Corrections Act directs the Department of the Interior to grant specific utility and transportation rights-of-way to the City of North Las Vegas and the Apex Industrial Park Owners Association, permanently withdraws transferred lands from public land laws, and exempts certain mineral sales from noncompetitive limitations.
